panel.title: Claude Code
panel.subtitle: Ask read-only questions about the IG repositories. Answers cite files at the commit they were read from.

form.promptPlaceholder: Ask about the code, a failing check, a pull request or the history of a file.
form.continuing: This adds a turn to the current session.

shortcuts.whyFailing: Explain why a check is failing
shortcuts.history: Trace the history of a file

job.paused: Paused at the step cap ({{cap}} steps). Continue to allow more steps within this job's budget.
job.blockedOnly: The job ended on a blocked action, shown above. No answer was produced.
job.noAnswer: The job finished without an answer.

attach.title: Attach this session to a ticket
attach.done: Attached to the ticket as an internal note.

access.title: Who can use the console
access.ownerNote: Only the owner can grant or revoke access.

errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can manage access.
errors.NOT_AWAITING_CONTINUE: This job is not paused at the step cap, so there is nothing to continue.
errors.VALIDATION: Check the request and try again.
errors.PROMPT_CONTAINS_SECRET: Your prompt looks like it contains a key or token. Remove it and resend.
errors.network: Could not reach the console. Check your connection and try again.
errors.LOOKUP_NOT_GRANTED: You have not been granted the user lookup.
errors.LOOKUP_DISABLED: The user lookup is switched off.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: That is the hourly lookup limit. Try again next hour.

lookup.title: User lookup
lookup.subtitle: Check one account's sign-in and usage state. Read-only; every lookup is recorded.
lookup.notFound: No account with this email: never created, or deleted (deletion removes the account entirely).
lookup.entitlementConflict: More than one entitlement row matches this account. The platform reads only one of them, so its answer can vary. All are shown.
lookup.cognitoMissing: No Cognito sign-in record for this account.
lookup.onboardedNote: Every magic-link sign-in sets this flag to true, whatever the account's real state.
lookup.lockoutCount: {{count}} failed attempts in the last {{minutes}} minutes; locked at {{limit}}.
lookup.locked: Locked out. It clears after a successful sign-in.
lookup.magicLink: Magic-link email delivery is not available here.
lookup.duplicate: More than one account has this email. Treat this card with care.
